eachadea__vicuna-13b-1.1.strengths: When on-task, gives accurate and well-organized answers, correctly explaining technical topics and getting specific facts right more often than most peers.
eachadea__vicuna-13b-1.1.performance: Medium-high: strong when engaged, but reliability is inconsistent across prompts.
eachadea__vicuna-13b-1.1.flaws: Frequently drifts into unrelated follow-on content after answering, invents a fake forum Q&A framing not present in the prompt, and responses are often truncated mid-sentence.
eachadea__vicuna-13b-1.1.traits: Adds fabricated question-and-answer scaffolding; long responses; occasional severe off-topic derailment.

TheBloke__koala-7B-HF.strengths: Organizes multi-step answers into clear numbered lists when it does engage with the actual question.
TheBloke__koala-7B-HF.performance: Low: most frequently fails to address the prompt at all among the pool.
TheBloke__koala-7B-HF.flaws: Systematically avoids answering by generating lists of tangentially related questions instead of a response; fabricates content (e.g. invented physics equations) when forced to answer directly.
TheBloke__koala-7B-HF.traits: Q&A-continuation pattern dominates output; numbered-list formatting; weak instruction adherence.

stabilityai__stablelm-tuned-alpha-7b.strengths: Capable of coherent, structured tip-lists on practical topics when not derailed into narrative mode.
stabilityai__stablelm-tuned-alpha-7b.performance: Low: least reliable on factual, technical, or list-based tasks in the pool.
stabilityai__stablelm-tuned-alpha-7b.flaws: Prone to verbatim repetition loops within a single response, drifts into unrelated fictional narrative regardless of task type, and produces clear historical/factual hallucinations.
stabilityai__stablelm-tuned-alpha-7b.traits: Repetition loops; narrative drift; occasional fully incoherent output on structured tasks.

OpenAssistant__oasst-sft-4-pythia-12b-ep.strengths: Consistently direct, on-topic, and appropriately concise across every prompt type observed, with no format failures or drift.
OpenAssistant__oasst-sft-4-pythia-12b-ep.performance: High: the most reliably task-adherent and well-calibrated model in the pool.
OpenAssistant__oasst-sft-4-pythia-12b-ep.flaws: Minor factual imprecision on some dates/details, but never wildly hallucinated or off-task.
OpenAssistant__oasst-sft-4-pythia-12b-ep.traits: Stable moderate length; direct answers; low variance in quality across topics.

google__flan-t5-xxl.strengths: Correct and appropriately terse on simple factual lookup questions.
google__flan-t5-xxl.performance: Mixed: fine on simple recall, breaks down sharply on complex, technical, or creative tasks.
google__flan-t5-xxl.flaws: Cannot elaborate: even creative-writing or multi-step prompts get a single flat sentence, and complex technical questions sometimes produce outright gibberish.
google__flan-t5-xxl.traits: Extreme, universal terseness; near-zero elaboration; unable to sustain longer generation.

chavinlo__alpaca-native.strengths: Generally answers the question directly with coherent, complete, moderate-length responses.
chavinlo__alpaca-native.performance: Medium: reliable most of the time, with occasional clear lapses.
chavinlo__alpaca-native.flaws: Occasionally drifts into unrelated continuation content after answering, contains some factual errors, and rarely ignores the prompt to list unrelated questions instead.
chavinlo__alpaca-native.traits: Mostly on-task; occasional topic drift; infrequent but real factual slips.

THUDM__chatglm-6b.strengths: Generally attempts to directly and thoroughly address the prompt with structured, numbered explanations.
THUDM__chatglm-6b.performance: Medium-low: on-task but frequently undermined by confidently stated factual errors.
THUDM__chatglm-6b.flaws: Pervasive leakage of Chinese words and phrases into English output, and a notable tendency toward confidently incorrect factual claims.
THUDM__chatglm-6b.traits: Systematic bilingual leakage; numbered-list structure; overconfident on facts it gets wrong.

mosesjun0h__llama-7b-hf-baize-lora-bf16.strengths: Content is generally accurate and reasonably well-organized when it stays on the actual question.
mosesjun0h__llama-7b-hf-baize-lora-bf16.performance: Medium: solid underlying answers, undercut by a distinct formatting habit.
mosesjun0h__llama-7b-hf-baize-lora-bf16.flaws: Frequently appends fabricated follow-up Q&A pairs after answering, and occasionally leaks raw chat-format markup tags into the output.
mosesjun0h__llama-7b-hf-baize-lora-bf16.traits: Self-generated bonus questions; occasional dialogue-tag leakage; some verbatim self-repetition.

databricks__dolly-v2-12b.strengths: Occasionally produces accurate, focused answers when generation stays stable.
databricks__dolly-v2-12b.performance: Low: the most erratic and unreliable model in the pool.
databricks__dolly-v2-12b.flaws: Frequent severe verbatim repetition loops, domain-mismatched non-sequitur output (e.g. code or linguistic tags for unrelated prompts), and poor arithmetic/reasoning accuracy.
databricks__dolly-v2-12b.traits: Repetition-loop collapse is dominant; unstable across almost every response type.

fnlp__moss-moon-003-sft.strengths: Generally direct, organized, on-topic answers with clear numbered structure; handles basic arithmetic and coding correctly.
fnlp__moss-moon-003-sft.performance: Medium-high: among the more functional and organized models in the pool.
fnlp__moss-moon-003-sft.flaws: Consistently appends self-generated, fabricated bonus Q&A pairs unrelated to the original prompt after the main answer.
fnlp__moss-moon-003-sft.traits: Unprompted extra-question generation; numbered-list structure; generally coherent.

mosaicml__mpt-7b-instruct.strengths: Produces coherent, factual content when it stays focused on the prompt.
mosaicml__mpt-7b-instruct.performance: Low-medium: frequently undermined by mid-response derailment.
mosaicml__mpt-7b-instruct.flaws: Very often drifts mid-generation into unrelated, seemingly web-scraped content (ads, unrelated trivia), and struggles with quantitative reasoning.
mosaicml__mpt-7b-instruct.traits: Topical derailment into unrelated training-data fragments; occasional hashtag or list-filler spam.
